image_description: A close-up view of a crocodile swimming in water, with only the top of its head (eyes and snout ridge) and a portion of its armored back visible above the surface. The rest of the body is submerged or obscured by ripples.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The full shape of the head and snout tip is not visible; only the eye ridge and partial snout base are seen above water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and submerged/obscured; no teeth are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes are clearly visible protruding from the water line, consistent with dorsal positioning. Vertical slit pupils are discernible upon close inspection.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tip of the snout is either submerged or out of frame/obscured by water distortion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible section of the back shows heavy armor/scutes, implying an elongated armored body typical of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct, rough, bony scutes are visible on the exposed back segment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color and texture of the visible scutes match the description (dark, rough).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface (belly) is completely submerged and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible above the water line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Water surface around the crocodile's back
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight inconsistency in water ripple patterns where they meet the crocodile's skin; some ripples appear to 'smudge' into the scutes rather than flowing naturally around the object, suggesting minor generation artifacts in fluid dynamics.

artifact_observations.location: Edges of the visible crocodile parts
artifact_observations.reasoning: Soft focus on the edges of the scutes and eyes, which could be depth-of-field but also resembles slight AI-generated edge bleeding.
